summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary share buyback transaction. On 22 April 2026, the company repurchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 100.5037 pence per share. The purchases are part of an existing buyback programme announced 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding share count. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The mechanics are a routine open-market repurchase under a pre-existing instruction. To watch: pace of future buybacks and impact on EPS and capital ratios.
